title: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B + DFlash block-diffusion spec-dec on one Spark
slug_note: The 122B lane that applies block-diffusion drafting to agent workloads: 81 tok/s median on real tool-call turns, accept length ~5.4 on code.

variation.quant_detail: AutoRound INT4 hybrid served with a DFlash block-diffusion draft

engine.config: one-shot curl|bash installer, prebuilt sm121 vLLM 0.23 image, DFlash draft for the 122B

requirements.notes: 40 GiB image + 67 GiB hybrid checkpoint; 16 GB unified free at READY on the dense profile.

steps: Choose the DFlash profile for agent workloads
--load-format fastsafetensors cuts time-to-READY to ~3 min versus ~12

measurements.method: repo harness: real agent tool-call turns regenerated, per-workload ladders
measurements.note: median DFlash decode on 10 real agent tool-call turns regenerated from a live agent state.db (73% tool calls, accept length 8.3), vs ~40 tok/s for the native MTP-2 head and 51.58 for albond's fully-patched MTP recipe

measurements.method: repo harness: real agent tool-call turns regenerated, per-workload ladders
measurements.note: agentic workload aggregate at 3 concurrent streams (per-stream 121.8 / 98.9 / 66.7)

measurements.method: repo harness: real agent tool-call turns regenerated, per-workload ladders
measurements.note: code workload single stream, DFlash n=12 (accept ~5.4) vs MTP-2 40.5 and base 28.2; at 3 streams 43.0 per stream, 129 aggregate

measurements.method: repo harness: real agent tool-call turns regenerated, per-workload ladders
measurements.note: counting workload single stream, accept length ~11 (MTP-2 caps at 43.7 because sequential drafting limits acceptance to ~3)

measurements.note: dense profile base decode with both levers (+28% over the 28.2 INT4 baseline; hybrid-FP8 alone 30.4, int8 lm-head alone 32.7)

measurements.note: free unified memory at READY on the default dense profile at gpu-mem 0.82 (~15 GiB under peak 3-stream load); 0.88-0.89 leaves only ~5 GiB and the host swaps

measurements.method: repo harness: real agent tool-call turns regenerated, per-workload ladders
measurements.note: time to READY with --load-format fastsafetensors (vs ~12 min on the default loader); weight read ~32 s vs ~8 min, remaining ~2.5 min is torch.compile (~42 s) + CUDA-graph capture (~2 min)

measurements.method: repo harness: real agent tool-call turns regenerated, per-workload ladders
measurements.note: minimum free disk (40 GiB image + 67 GiB hybrid checkpoint + 1.6 GiB drafter); >=150 GiB with --build-hybrid

caveats: The 119 GB figure is the box's usable unified memory, not this setup's footprint; kept out of the measurements.
DFlash on the 122B is a fork-path feature: stock vLLM will not reproduce it, so reproducibility depends on the prebuilt image.
The checkpoint card states no license field; the weights lineage is Qwen Apache-2.0.
